title: CUSP: Cutoff-conditioned Unseen Scientific Progress
description: CUSP is a benchmark for evaluating whether AI systems can forecast scientific progress under historical knowledge cutoffs. Each item is grounded to a published scientific paper and includes binary, multiple-choice, free-response, and date-prediction task variants. Evaluation uses a two-track LLM-as-judge framework with leakage detection. This repository contains the evaluation harness, analysis code, and visualization code; the dataset is hosted at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SeanWu25/CUSP.
